games.name: Horizon Blue: 1919
games.desc:
GAME IS IN ALPHA

The Horizon has never been so dull, a landscape shattered by years of relentless artillery and broken promises. Verdun, once again, becomes the forefront of the War. The German war machine thrusts inward into the ravaged citadel of France, seeking a final, decisive blow...

In The War That Ended All Wars, history fractures. Step into the muddied boots of weary yet unbroken infantrymen in a brutal, lengthy player-driven campaign. Will you push the offensive and carve a path through Verdun—or stand your ground as the fiercest bastion of Allied resistance against the German Army.

CONTROLS:
WASD - Move
L. CTRL - Mouse lock
QE - Switch Shoulder View
BV - Equip & Arm Bayonet
Tab F8 F10 - Scoreboard, Settings & Info
M1 M2 - Fire, Aim
M1 - While loop reloading: Cancel
R - Reload, Detonate
Z - Toggle aim
P - Mute Music

Desktop Recommended. Performances settings in F8 menu.
Credits in-game, in the Info menu.

For any further inquiries, do not hesitate to contact me directly !

games.name: [SEASON 1] Race Around The World
games.desc:
Race against other teams around the world. You will get to visit all kinds of cities, countries, and some famous landmarks. Along the way, teams will be eliminated at Checkpoints, but the first team to cross the Finish Line will win the Race Around The World!

Private servers allow you to play in Practice Mode and include an admin system that gives you more control over the game. This includes setting the legs and choosing locations for each leg before the game begins.

Please note that only the owner of the private server can use the admin system. Other players will not have access to these controls.

If you enjoy playing Race Around The World (RATW), please be sure to give the experience a thumbs up 👍

games.name: Subterra ⛏️ [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!
